items.label: section_header
items.text: LEARNINGOBJECTIVES

items.label: list_item
items.text: Understand that H2O, Cl and NH3 act as monodentate ligands

items.label: list_item
items.text: Understand the terms'bidentate'and'hexadentate'in relation to ligands, and be able to identify examples such as NH2CH2CH2NH2 and EDTA4-

items.label: list_item
items.text: Know that haemoglobin is an iron(ll) complex containing a polydentate ligand and that ligand exchange occurs when an oxygen molecule bound to haemoglobin is replaced by a carbon monoxide molecule.

items.label: list_item
items.text: Understand, in terms of the positive increase in Ssystem, that the substitution of a monodentate ligand by a bidentate or hexadentateligandleadstoamorestablecomplexion.
